items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ernie Royal started out with us, but he didn’t – he always put us out, because he was so busy.

ctx.x: Ernie – Ernie Royal play with that?
Ernie Royal started out with us, but he didn’t – he always put us out, because he was so busy. He’d say, “I think this band should disband.” Yeah, Copeland was one of our mainstays.
